_doc: UPDATE 10 §7 (contract C7, DECISIONS T-163): the bots' rules for Fernflug's set-pieces (gravelight/bots/bot_setpieces.gd, BotSetPieces). Per-map positions live in routes_<map>.json 'setpieces' (the meteor shelters, the radar perch). Bot tuning only: nothing here changes a set-piece for a human.

stand_fast._doc: Q-19 (T-163): acts too tight to run from sprinters: the squad stands together and shoots every round there (BotBrain.stand_fast, the special round's rule: no sprint-away retreat, no solo training, no window holds). In the Kranich the bots died backing into the hull walls.

moves._doc: A non-urgent move (wing walk, lever, pad, the walk to the perch) gives the body back to the fight while a zombie is within yield_m; a rail in a breach's pull, the meteor shelter and the perch once climbed keep it.

storm._doc: Act III's dust storm (GroomController.dust_active): no sprinting, the formation at spacing_mult, and no shot at a stalker (Zombie.hunt_by_sound) farther than quiet_fire_m unless it is within on_us_m or chasing this bot, a teammate is down or the bot is under half health. A shot makes every stalker within 18 m hear it (SoundHunter: 6 m x3).

collapse._doc: Act III's wreck: a warned section's box is a danger disc (its half diagonal + margin_m, cost) until it falls; the burning hull's spread_points are fire discs for good.

decompression._doc: Act II's breaches (DecompressionBreach): warning or pulling and the bot within radius + grip_margin_m: the nearest rail_grips rail of that breach, held until it is over; no rail: out of the radius.

wing_walk._doc: Act II's wing walk as a risky optional task: one bot, self-led squads / Full Partner / ordered, only in a break or with nothing known within quiet_m, hp at least hp_min, never in a warned tilt; clip in at the first tether post, the wingtip locker's token (and part), back in. Given up after max_s.

meteor._doc: Act IV's meteor shower: from the warning to the end, out of the yard box (grown by box_margin_m) to the nearest shelter point.

shaft_grate._doc: Act IV's vent: within use_within_m of the lever, min_dead known zombies on the grate, and the price leaves reserve_scrip.

jump_pads._doc: Act IV's pads as route links: on a trip of at least min_trip_m, a pad within max_detour_m whose landing saves gain_m of path; never with a zombie within quiet_m.

perch._doc: Act III's radar tower perch: the high-ground shooter goes up with nothing within quiet_m, comes down when crowd zombies are within 4 m of the deck, below hp_min, a teammate down, the storm or the break; cooldown_s before the next climb.
